<!-- Thanks for contributing! A maintainer reviews every PR by hand. -->

## Checklist (contributor)
- [ ] I searched the library (`sceneparts search`) and nothing similar exists.
- [ ] `sceneparts check <id>` passes and I looked at the preview it made.
- [ ] I made this part myself or generated it with AI from my own prompts.
- [ ] It doesn't copy an existing character, brand, logo or artwork, and doesn't depict a real person.
- [ ] It's suitable for all ages.
- [ ] I release it under the MIT licence, and my commits are signed off (`git commit -s`).

## Reviewer
- [ ] Looks right in its style at the preview sizes; nothing cut off or broken
- [ ] Original (not a known character / brand / real person) – check the `needs-ip-check` label if present
- [ ] Summary, tags and params are accurate and useful for search
- [ ] Not a duplicate (check the `possible-duplicate` label if present)
